# Needs a test build (make TEST=1) or the simulator: the synthetic camera.
# Made from tests/signer/signer.txt.in by tests/signer/make_scenario.py.
# The Signer (apps/signer): the transaction first, then the keys. Each PSBT
# is seen with its change only claimed, then checked once the keys are in.
# The key is the BIP-39 test phrase "abandon ... about" (entropy: 16 zero
# bytes; public, no real funds), split 2-of-3 with identifier ZGSQ. Electrum's
# PSBTs are Electrum 4.8.3's own QR codes (tests/signer/electrum.json): the
# signed transactions must hash as Electrum's own (SHA-256 shown, first 8
# bytes). The others come from tests/signer/run_node.mjs --made-out.
# The log holds no share, word or key: only counts, sizes and hashes.
expect Keyboard attached 60
expect launcher ready 60
tile signer
expect signer ready 10
expect signer selftest: 4 passed, 0 failed 30
wait 0.5
shot 01-home
